name: Filled Soul Gem
summary: The Filled Soul Gem holds Yenniku's soul after the Soul Gem is used on him. Nimboya asks you to bring it back to Grom'gol.

sections.title: A Soul Restored
sections.body: At the Ruins of Aboraz on the Cape of Stranglethorn, the Soul Gem is placed upon Yenniku's head to capture his soul. Bring the filled gem to Nimboya in Grom'gol, where his people await his return.

faq.q: What is the Filled Soul Gem?
faq.answer: The Filled Soul Gem contains Yenniku's soul, captured with the Soul Gem at the Ruins of Aboraz.
Yenniku is a member of Nimboya's tribe who is held under Zanzil the Outcast's will.

faq.q: Where do I take the gem?
faq.answer: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya at Grom'gol.

faq.q: How was the Soul Gem made?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem, which captures Yenniku's soul.
